title: SEC proposes transfer agent rule, sets event to figure out round-the-clock U.S. trading
summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued an agenda for its 24-trading roundtable and proposed a new transfer-agent rule with blockchain implications.

title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
summary: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
summary: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.

title: Musk’s X hit by wave of unsolicited password reset emails
summary: Multiple crypto industry figures and CoinDesk staff received unexpected password reset emails on Tuesday, though there is no evidence yet that X itself has been breached.

title: Firelight raises $8 million, expands beyond XRP as it aims to make DeFi less scary for fintechs
summary: The protocol aims to give fintechs and investors a faster way to recover losses from DeFi hacks, while letting XRP, bitcoin and XLM holders earn yield by backing that protection.
